items.title_cn: 中国DeepSeek引发AI股广泛抛售，股市大幅下挫
items.title_en: Stocks Sink in Broad AI Rout Sparked by China's DeepSeek
items.summary_cn: 中国AI公司DeepSeek以极低成本实现高性能模型，引发市场对AI算力投资逻辑的质疑，导致英伟达等科技股大幅下跌。这标志着AI竞争进入效率优先的新阶段，投资者需重新评估算力需求与估值泡沫，值得关注。
items.summary_en: Chinese AI firm DeepSeek's low-cost, high-performance model has triggered a broad sell-off in AI stocks, casting doubt on the logic of massive AI compute investments and sending Nvidia and other tech shares tumbling. This marks a new phase of efficiency-driven AI competition, prompting investors to reassess compute demand and valuation bubbles.

items.title_cn: Comex黄金与白银期货收低
items.title_en: Comex Gold, Silver Settle Lower
items.summary_cn: Comex黄金和白银期货在最新交易日中收低，反映出市场对美联储货币政策预期、美元走势及避险情绪的综合定价。贵金属价格承压可能源于美债收益率上行或美元走强，削弱了无息资产的吸引力。值得关注的是，这一走势是否意味着短期回调的开始，还是长期上行趋势中的震荡，将影响投资者对通胀对冲和资产配置的判断。
items.summary_en: Comex gold and silver futures settled lower in the latest trading session, reflecting the market's combined pricing of Federal Reserve policy expectations, U.S. dollar movements, and risk sentiment. The pressure on precious metals may stem from rising Treasury yields or a stronger dollar, which reduces the appeal of non-yielding assets. It is worth watching whether this move signals the start of a short-term correction or merely a fluctuation within a longer uptrend, as it will influence investors' judgments on inflation hedging and asset allocation.

items.title_cn: DeepSeek 不会击沉美国 AI 巨头
items.title_en: DeepSeek Won't Sink U.S. AI Titans
items.summary_cn: DeepSeek 的崛起引发市场对美国 AI 巨头前景的担忧，但本文认为这种恐慌被过度放大。文章指出，美国科技巨头在算力、生态和商业化上仍有深厚护城河，DeepSeek 的高效低成本模型更多是推动行业进步，而非颠覆现有格局。值得一读，因为它理性拆解了竞争威胁与真实影响，帮助投资者避免情绪化决策。
items.summary_en: DeepSeek's rise has sparked fears about the prospects of U.S. AI giants, but this article argues the panic is overblown. It notes that American tech leaders still have deep moats in compute, ecosystems, and commercialization, and DeepSeek's efficient, low-cost models are more likely to advance the industry than upend it. A worthwhile read because it rationally separates competitive threats from real impact, helping investors avoid emotional decisions.

items.title_cn: 金融服务综述：市场观察
items.title_en: Financial Services Roundup: Market Talk
items.summary_cn: 本文汇总了金融服务领域的最新市场动态与机构观点，涵盖银行、保险、资产管理等细分板块的交易情绪与关键评论。内容精选自全球主要市场参与者的实时对话，帮助读者快速把握资金流向、政策预期及风险偏好变化。对于关注金融股走势与行业轮动的投资者而言，这是一份高效的信息速览，能在一篇之内获取多家机构的核心判断，节省独立搜集的时间成本。
items.summary_en: This roundup compiles the latest market developments and institutional views in the financial services sector, covering trading sentiment and key commentary across banking, insurance, and asset management. Drawn from real-time conversations among major global market participants, it helps readers quickly grasp capital flows, policy expectations, and shifts in risk appetite. For investors tracking financial stocks and sector rotation, this is an efficient briefing that consolidates core judgments from multiple institutions in one place, saving the time cost of independent collection.

items.title_cn: 美哥关税争端升级 阿拉比卡咖啡价格创历史新高
items.title_en: Arabica Coffee Prices Hit Record on U.S., Colombia Tariff Spat
items.summary_cn: 受美国与哥伦比亚之间关税摩擦影响，阿拉比卡咖啡期货价格飙升至历史最高水平。市场担忧供应中断，因哥伦比亚是美国最大的咖啡供应国之一，而关税威胁可能扰乱贸易流并推高全球咖啡成本。此次价格暴涨凸显了地缘政治与贸易政策对软商品市场的直接冲击，投资者需关注后续谈判进展及对通胀的潜在传导效应。
items.summary_en: Arabica coffee futures surged to a record high amid a tariff spat between the U.S. and Colombia. Market concerns over supply disruptions mounted, as Colombia is one of the largest coffee suppliers to the U.S., and tariff threats could disrupt trade flows and raise global coffee costs. The price spike highlights the direct impact of geopolitics and trade policy on soft commodity markets, with investors watching for further negotiations and potential inflationary pass-through.

items.title_cn: DeepSeek消息提振避险需求，瑞郎与日元走强
items.title_en: Swiss franc, Japanese yen Rise as DeepSeek News Boosts Safe Havens
items.summary_cn: DeepSeek相关消息引发市场避险情绪升温，瑞士法郎与日元等传统避险货币应声走强。这一动态值得关注，因为它反映出投资者对科技行业不确定性及潜在宏观经济连锁反应的担忧，可能预示着资金正从风险资产转向安全资产，对全球汇市和风险偏好具有重要参考意义。
items.summary_en: News related to DeepSeek has triggered a rise in market risk aversion, driving traditional safe-haven currencies such as the Swiss franc and Japanese yen higher. This development is noteworthy because it reflects investor concerns over uncertainties in the tech sector and potential macroeconomic spillovers, potentially signaling a shift from risk assets to safe havens, with important implications for global forex markets and risk sentiment.

items.title_cn: 天气预报转向导致天然气价格下跌
items.title_en: Natural Gas Falls on Shifting Weather Forecasts
items.summary_cn: 天然气价格因天气预报变化而承压下行。最新气象模型显示，主要消费区的降温幅度或持续时间不及此前预期，削弱了取暖需求前景，触发多头平仓与短线抛售。此次波动凸显天气因素在短期定价中的主导地位，也反映市场对供需平衡的敏感。值得关注的是，若后续预报再度转冷，价格可能迅速反弹，交易者需警惕高波动风险。
items.summary_en: Natural gas prices fell as shifting weather forecasts pressured the market. Updated models indicated less intense or shorter-lived cold in key demand regions, weakening the heating-demand outlook and triggering long liquidation and short-term selling. The move highlights weather's dominant role in near-term pricing and the market's sensitivity to supply-demand balances. Notably, if forecasts turn colder again, prices could rebound quickly, so traders should watch for elevated volatility.

items.title_cn: 建材分销商QXO对Beacon发起敌意收购
items.title_en: Building-Products Distributor QXO Launches Hostile Bid for Beacon
items.summary_cn: 建材分销巨头QXO对竞争对手Beacon发起敌意收购，此举可能重塑北美建材分销市场格局。QXO由亿万富翁布拉德·雅各布斯领导，此次收购若成功，将打造一个年收入超百亿美元的行业巨头。值得关注的是，敌意收购在建材分销领域较为罕见，可能引发行业整合浪潮，并对上下游议价能力产生深远影响。投资者需关注Beacon的防御策略及监管审批风险。
items.summary_en: Building-products distribution giant QXO has launched a hostile bid for rival Beacon, a move that could reshape the North American building-materials distribution landscape. Led by billionaire Brad Jacobs, QXO aims to create an industry giant with over $10 billion in annual revenue if the acquisition succeeds. Notably, hostile bids are rare in this sector, potentially triggering a wave of consolidation and significantly impacting bargaining power across the supply chain. Investors should watch Beacon's defense strategies and regulatory approval risks.

items.title_cn: 盘前大变动：派拉蒙、华纳兄弟、埃森哲、诺和诺德等股票值得关注
items.title_en: Stocks making the biggest moves premarket: Paramount, Warner Bros., Accenture, Novo & more
items.summary_cn: 盘前交易揭示市场情绪与资金流向，派拉蒙、华纳兄弟等传媒股或受并购消息影响，埃森哲作为IT咨询龙头可能发布财报或指引，诺和诺德则延续减肥药赛道波动。这些异动股往往预示当日热点，为投资者提供短线机会与风险信号，值得密切跟踪。
items.summary_en: Premarket trading reveals market sentiment and capital flows. Media stocks like Paramount and Warner Bros. may be reacting to M&A news, Accenture as an IT consulting leader could release earnings or guidance, and Novo Nordisk continues volatility in the weight-loss drug sector. These movers often signal the day's hotspots, offering short-term opportunities and risk signals for investors to watch closely.

items.title_cn: 关税、油价与利率三重夹击，美国企业不堪重负：“情况糟透了”
items.title_en: 'It's awful': How tariffs, soaring fuel costs and higher interest rates are squeezing American companies
items.summary_cn: 本文剖析了关税、飙升的燃料成本与高利率如何形成合力，挤压美国企业的利润空间，尤其对制造商、汽车供应商、零售商和运输业造成沉重打击。文章通过具体案例揭示了企业面临的成本转嫁困境与需求疲软双重压力，值得关注美国经济微观层面真实痛点的读者一读。
items.summary_en: This article examines how tariffs, soaring fuel costs, and higher interest rates are combining to squeeze profit margins for American companies, particularly manufacturers, auto suppliers, retailers, and transportation businesses. Through specific cases, it reveals the dual pressures of cost pass-through difficulties and weakening demand, offering a valuable look at the real pain points in the micro-level U.S. economy.

items.title_cn: 凯文·沃什三字箴言令华尔街困惑：美联储加息究竟会走多远
items.title_en: Three words from Kevin Warsh have Wall Street wondering how far the Fed will go with rate hikes
items.summary_cn: 美联储主席凯文·沃什本周不仅解释了加息决定，更用三个关键词引发市场对后续政策路径的激烈猜测。沃什的措辞暗示美联储可能比预期更激进，或更谨慎，但模糊性本身成为最大风险。投资者急于解读这三字背后的真实意图，因为它直接关系到利率峰值、经济软着陆概率以及全球资产定价。本文剖析沃什言论的微妙之处，揭示华尔街为何陷入分歧，以及未来几周需要紧盯的关键信号。
items.summary_en: Fed Chairman Kevin Warsh not only explained this week's rate hike but also sparked intense market speculation about the future policy path with three key words. His phrasing hints the Fed could be more aggressive or more cautious than expected, but the ambiguity itself becomes the biggest risk. Investors are scrambling to decipher the true meaning behind those three words, as it directly affects the peak rate, the odds of a soft landing, and global asset pricing. This article analyzes the nuances of Warsh's remarks, why Wall Street is divided, and the key signals to watch in the coming weeks.

items.title_cn: 盘前股价大幅波动个股：奈飞、纽柯钢铁、Xenon制药等
items.title_en: Stocks making the biggest moves premarket: Netflix, Nucor, Xenon Pharmaceuticals & more
items.summary_cn: 盘前交易中，奈飞、纽柯钢铁、Xenon制药等个股出现显著波动，通常反映最新财报、并购消息或行业动态。投资者可借此提前捕捉市场情绪与潜在交易机会，尤其关注奈飞流媒体竞争及Xenon生物医药进展，以判断开盘后走势。
items.summary_en: In premarket trading, stocks such as Netflix, Nucor, and Xenon Pharmaceuticals are showing significant moves, often reflecting earnings, M&A news, or sector developments. Investors can use these early signals to gauge market sentiment and potential trading opportunities, especially watching Netflix's streaming competition and Xenon's biopharma progress to anticipate the opening trend.

items.title_cn: 巴菲特卸任伯克希尔哈撒韦董事长：“时间老人永远不败”
items.title_en: Warren Buffett steps down as chairman of Berkshire Hathaway: 'Father Time always wins'
items.summary_cn: 95岁的“股神”沃伦·巴菲特正式卸任伯克希尔哈撒韦董事长，结束长达六十年的掌舵生涯。其子霍华德·巴菲特将按既定继任计划接任董事长，但阿贝尔仍将出任CEO。这一交接标志着全球最具传奇色彩的投资帝国进入后巴菲特时代，投资者需关注权力过渡对公司战略、资本配置及市场信心的深远影响。
items.summary_en: Warren Buffett, the 95-year-old 'Oracle of Omaha,' has officially stepped down as chairman of Berkshire Hathaway, ending a six-decade reign. His son Howard Buffett will succeed him as chairman under a long-standing succession plan, while Abel remains CEO. This transition marks the end of an era for the world's most legendary investment empire, and investors should watch how the power shift affects strategy, capital allocation, and market confidence.

items.title_cn: 监管放行部分代币化美股交易，Securitize股价应声大涨
items.title_en: Securitize jumps after regulators greenlight some tokenized U.S. stock trading
items.summary_cn: 美国联邦监管机构批准部分交易平台发行代币化股票，区块链资产代币化公司Securitize周四股价大幅飙升。此举标志着传统金融与加密技术融合迈出关键一步，可能为美股交易带来更高效率和更广的全球可及性。投资者应关注代币化股票对市场结构、流动性及监管框架的深远影响，这或将成为下一轮金融创新的重要催化剂。
items.summary_en: Federal regulators have approved the issuance of tokenized stocks on some trading platforms in the U.S., sending shares of blockchain tokenization firm Securitize surging on Thursday. This marks a key step in the convergence of traditional finance and crypto technology, potentially bringing greater efficiency and broader global accessibility to U.S. stock trading. Investors should watch how tokenized stocks reshape market structure, liquidity, and the regulatory framework, as this could become a major catalyst for the next wave of financial innovation.

items.title_cn: 午盘异动股：Workday、Generac、Vital Farms、Vicor、Tower Semi等
items.title_en: Stocks making the biggest moves midday: Workday, Generac, Vital Farms, Vicor, Tower Semi & more
items.summary_cn: 本文汇总了美股午盘期间出现大幅波动的个股，涵盖Workday、Generac、Vital Farms、Vicor、Tower Semiconductor等。这些异动往往反映了财报、分析师评级调整或行业消息的即时冲击，为短线交易者和市场观察者提供了捕捉资金流向与情绪变化的关键窗口。通过追踪这些个股，投资者可快速把握当日市场热点及潜在交易机会。
items.summary_en: This article rounds up the stocks that saw the largest midday moves, including Workday, Generac, Vital Farms, Vicor, Tower Semiconductor, and more. These swings often reflect immediate reactions to earnings, analyst rating changes, or sector news, offering short-term traders and market watchers a key window into capital flows and sentiment shifts. By tracking these names, investors can quickly identify the day's market hotspots and potential trading opportunities.

items.title_cn: 中国AI公司月之暗面接入华尔街顶级数据提供商
items.title_en: A Chinese AI company just connected its model to Wall Street's leading data providers
items.summary_cn: 中国AI初创公司月之暗面宣布与中金公司等金融巨头及风投机构签约，将其大模型接入华尔街主流数据源。此举标志着中国AI企业首次深度渗透全球金融核心数据链，有望重塑投研、风控与交易策略的智能化流程。值得关注的是，在中美科技博弈背景下，这一合作既展示了中国AI技术的商业化落地能力，也引发对数据跨境与金融安全的讨论。
items.summary_en: Chinese AI startup Moonshot announced partnerships with financial giants including investment bank CICC and venture capital firms, integrating its large language model with Wall Street's leading data providers. This marks the first time a Chinese AI company has deeply penetrated the core data chain of global finance, potentially reshaping intelligent workflows in investment research, risk control, and trading strategies. Notably, amid US-China tech tensions, this collaboration demonstrates the commercialization capability of Chinese AI while raising discussions on cross-border data and financial security.

items.title_cn: 马克龙与特朗普讨论俄乌停止能源设施打击
items.title_en: Macron and Trump Discuss Kyiv and Moscow Halting Energy Strikes
items.summary_cn: 法国总统马克龙在纽约与特朗普会面时，提出俄乌双方暂停对能源资产深度打击的设想。此举若成真，将是冲突降级的重要信号，但特朗普重返白宫后的对乌政策仍存变数。值得关注的是，能源设施停火能否成为全面停火的第一步，以及美欧在援乌问题上的协调走向。
items.summary_en: French President Emmanuel Macron said he discussed the idea of a moratorium on deep strikes against energy assets between Ukraine and Russia during a meeting with Donald Trump in New York. If realized, this would be a significant signal of de-escalation, though Trump's Ukraine policy after returning to the White House remains uncertain. Key questions include whether an energy infrastructure ceasefire could become a first step toward a full ceasefire, and how the US and Europe will coordinate on aid to Ukraine.

items.title_cn: 科技乐观情绪提振亚股，油价因伊朗局势缓和希望下跌
items.title_en: Asian Stocks to Gain on Tech Optimism, Oil Falls: Markets Wrap
items.summary_cn: 隔夜华尔街科技股推动美股走高，叠加市场对伊朗战争外交进展的期待导致油价回落，亚洲股市有望延续涨势。投资者正密切关注地缘政治风险缓和的信号，以及科技板块能否继续引领全球风险偏好。这一组合若持续，可能为区域市场提供短期支撑，但需警惕油价波动与中东局势反复带来的不确定性。
items.summary_en: Asian equities are poised to rise following a tech-driven rally on Wall Street and a decline in oil prices amid hopes for diplomatic progress in the Iran conflict. Investors are closely watching signals of easing geopolitical risks and whether the tech sector can continue to drive global risk appetite. If sustained, this combination could offer short-term support for regional markets, though uncertainty remains over oil price volatility and the trajectory of Middle East tensions.

items.title_cn: 越南领导人称越美贸易协议即将达成
items.title_en: Vietnam’s Leader Declares US Trade Deal Close
items.summary_cn: 越南最高领导人苏林在联合国大会期间接受彭博社独家采访时表示，越南与美国“非常接近”达成一项贸易协议。苏林指出，越南希望增加从美国进口商品，以平衡双边贸易关系。此举正值全球供应链重组和地缘政治紧张加剧之际，越南作为制造业转移的重要目的地，其与美国的贸易谈判进展备受关注。若协议达成，将进一步深化两国经济联系，并可能影响区域贸易格局。
items.summary_en: Vietnam’s top leader To Lam said in an exclusive interview with Bloomberg on the sidelines of the UN General Assembly that the nation is “very close” to reaching a trade deal with the US. Lam noted that Vietnam wants to import more US goods to balance bilateral trade. This comes amid global supply chain restructuring and rising geopolitical tensions, with Vietnam as a key destination for manufacturing shifts, making its trade talks with the US closely watched. A deal would further deepen economic ties and potentially reshape regional trade dynamics.

items.title_cn: 原油市场最新动态与分析：9月22日
items.title_en: Latest Oil Market News and Analysis for Sept. 22
items.summary_cn: 油价在经历连续四日累计下跌超9%后企稳，主要因中东供应担忧缓解，且市场观察到结束美伊冲突的努力似有增加。本文值得关注，因为它揭示了地缘政治风险溢价消退与供需基本面之间的微妙平衡，为判断短期油价走势提供了关键线索。
items.summary_en: Oil prices steadied after losing more than 9% over the previous four days, as Middle East supply concerns eased and traders tracked an apparent uptick in efforts to end the US-Iran conflict. This is worth watching because it reveals the delicate balance between fading geopolitical risk premiums and supply-demand fundamentals, offering key clues for short-term oil price direction.

items.title_cn: 厄瓜多尔每日向美国求援，打击年产值300亿美元可卡因贸易
items.title_en: Ecuador Asks US Daily to Help Curb $30 Billion Cocaine Trade
items.summary_cn: 厄瓜多尔总统诺沃亚周一表示，该国“每天”都在向美国寻求更多援助，以打击年估值高达300亿美元的可卡因贸易，同时坚持当地安全部队应继续主导行动。这一表态凸显厄瓜多尔正从相对和平的过境国沦为毒品暴力重灾区，其求援背后是拉美禁毒合作的新动向与美国介入尺度的微妙博弈。值得关注的是，诺沃亚在寻求外部支持的同时强调主权掌控，反映了小国在跨国犯罪压力下平衡安全需求与自主权的现实困境。
items.summary_en: Ecuadorian President Daniel Noboa said Monday that his country asks the US 'every day' for more help fighting a cocaine trade worth an estimated $30 billion a year, while insisting local security forces should remain in charge. This statement highlights Ecuador's transformation from a relatively peaceful transit country into a hotspot of drug-related violence, and its appeal reflects new dynamics in Latin American anti-drug cooperation and a delicate game over the scale of US involvement. Notably, Noboa's emphasis on sovereignty while seeking external support illustrates the real dilemma small nations face in balancing security needs and autonomy under pressure from transnational crime.

items.title_cn: 派拉蒙和解诉讼扫清障碍，1100亿美元收购华纳兄弟探索即将完成
items.title_en: Paramount settles lawsuits, allowing for Warner Bros. deal
items.summary_cn: 派拉蒙天舞与12位州检察长及美国编剧工会达成诉讼和解，为完成对华纳兄弟探索高达1100亿美元的历史性收购扫清了最后障碍。这笔交易将重塑好莱坞格局，使派拉蒙一举掌控华纳旗下众多顶级影视IP与流媒体平台，行业集中度大幅提升。值得关注的是，和解条款是否涉及内容创作或劳工权益的承诺，以及监管层面对超大规模媒体并购的态度转变，都将深刻影响未来传媒产业的竞争生态。
items.summary_en: Paramount Skydance has reached settlements with 12 state attorneys general and the Writers Guild, clearing the final hurdles for its landmark $110 billion acquisition of Warner Bros. Discovery. The deal will reshape Hollywood by giving Paramount control of Warner's vast portfolio of premium film and TV IP and streaming platforms, significantly increasing industry consolidation. Key questions remain: whether the settlement includes commitments on content creation or labor rights, and how regulators' stance on mega media mergers will shape the future competitive landscape of the entertainment industry.

items.title_cn: 美国拟设立50亿美元中东重建基金 用于伊朗战争后基础设施修复
items.title_en: US Plans $5 Billion Middle East Reconstruction Fund for Iran War
items.summary_cn: 特朗普政府提议设立50亿美元基金，用于重建因与伊朗战争而受损的中东关键基础设施，而这场已持续七个月的冲突仍在继续。该计划值得关注，因为它揭示了一个矛盾信号：美国一边仍在进行军事行动，一边已着手规划战后重建，可能暗示冲突进入新阶段或美方试图争取地区民心。50亿美元规模相对有限，能否覆盖广泛破坏存疑，且资金来源与执行机制尚不明确。此举还可能引发国会质疑，并影响美国与伊朗及地区盟友的外交博弈。
items.summary_en: The Trump administration has proposed a $5 billion fund to rebuild critical Middle East infrastructure damaged in the war with Iran, even as the seven-month conflict continues. This plan is noteworthy because it sends a contradictory signal: the US is still engaged militarily while already planning post-war reconstruction, possibly hinting at a new phase in the conflict or an attempt to win regional goodwill. The $5 billion scale seems limited relative to widespread damage, and funding sources and implementation mechanisms remain unclear. It could also trigger congressional scrutiny and affect US diplomatic maneuvering with Iran and regional allies.

items.title_cn: RBC策略师Grimba：ETF行业仍有多年增长空间，但竞争白热化
items.title_en: 'Years of Growth Left': Grimba
items.summary_cn: RBC资本市场全球ETF策略总监Valerie Grimba做客彭博ETF IQ节目，与主持人探讨ETF新基金发行激增的现象及发行商如何在日益拥挤的市场中竞争。Grimba认为行业仍有多年增长潜力，但产品同质化与渠道争夺正加剧行业洗牌。对于关注ETF资金流向、产品创新及行业格局的投资者而言，这段对话提供了来自一线策略师的稀缺判断。
items.summary_en: Valerie Grimba, RBC Capital Markets Director of Global ETF Strategy, joins Bloomberg ETF IQ with Scarlet Fu and Eric Balchunas to discuss the surge in new fund launches and how ETF issuers compete in an increasingly crowded space. Grimba sees years of growth left for the industry, but product homogenization and distribution battles are intensifying consolidation. For investors tracking ETF flows, product innovation, and industry structure, this conversation offers rare insights from a top strategist.

items.title_cn: 克里姆林宫支持的伪造计划通过全球银行转移69亿美元
items.title_en: Kremlin-backed forgery scheme moved $6.9bn through global banks
items.summary_cn: 英国《金融时报》从金融科技公司A7内部获取的大量泄露文件显示，与克里姆林宫有关联的伪造计划通过渣打银行、花旗集团等国际银行完成了数千笔俄罗斯付款，总额高达69亿美元。这一发现揭示了西方制裁背景下，全球银行体系如何被利用来转移受制裁资金，凸显了金融监管漏洞与地缘政治博弈的深度交织。读者可借此了解制裁规避的运作机制及其对国际金融秩序的潜在冲击。
items.summary_en: A vast leak from inside fintech A7, obtained by the Financial Times, reveals that a Kremlin-backed forgery scheme moved $6.9bn through global banks including Standard Chartered and Citigroup, involving thousands of Russian payments. The findings expose how the global banking system has been exploited to transfer sanctioned funds despite Western sanctions, highlighting the deep entanglement of regulatory loopholes and geopolitical rivalry. Readers can gain insight into the mechanics of sanctions evasion and its potential impact on the international financial order.

items.title_cn: Lex深度解析：Anthropic IPO面临的棘手估值数学题
items.title_en: Lex in depth: the challenging maths of Anthropic’s IPO
items.summary_cn: 本文深入探讨了AI独角兽Anthropic上市时可能遇到的估值难题。文章指出，破解其估值谜题存在多种路径，部分观点认为该公司价值可能远超市场预期。对于关注AI行业投资与IPO动态的读者而言，本文提供了对Anthropic估值逻辑与潜在市场分歧的关键洞察，值得细读。
items.summary_en: This article delves into the valuation challenges Anthropic may face when going public. It notes that there are several ways to crack the valuation puzzle, with some suggesting the company could be worth far more than expected. For readers interested in AI investment and IPO trends, this piece offers key insights into Anthropic's valuation logic and potential market divergence, making it a worthwhile read.

items.title_cn: 特朗普与习近平：错误时代的错误领袖
items.title_en: Trump and Xi are the wrong men at the wrong time
items.summary_cn: 文章尖锐指出，当今世界亟需具有远见卓识的领导力来应对气候变化、经济衰退与地缘冲突等全球性挑战，然而美中两国领导人却难以担此重任。特朗普聚焦短期利益与对抗性策略，习近平则受制于内部压力与零和思维，二者均缺乏真正的全球视野。本文值得一读，因为它揭示了当前国际秩序困境的核心：不是缺少解决方案，而是缺少愿意超越自身利益、为全球公共利益负责的领导者。
items.summary_en: The article sharply argues that the world urgently needs far-sighted leadership to tackle global challenges such as climate change, economic downturn, and geopolitical conflicts, yet the leaders of the US and China are unlikely to provide it. Trump focuses on short-term interests and confrontational tactics, while Xi is constrained by internal pressures and zero-sum thinking—neither possesses a truly global vision. This piece is worth reading because it reveals the core dilemma of the current international order: it is not a lack of solutions, but a lack of leaders willing to transcend their own interests and take responsibility for the global common good.

items.title_cn: 撕裂墨西哥一州的贩毒集团内战
items.title_en: The cartel civil war tearing apart a Mexican state
items.summary_cn: 2024年，锡那罗亚贩毒集团爆发内讧：大毒枭“矮子”古兹曼之子绑架了其父的联合创始人，并将其移交给美国当局。这一背叛引爆了集团内部残酷的权力争夺，导致墨西哥锡那罗亚州陷入暴力漩涡。本文深度剖析这场内战如何撕裂当地社会、冲击地缘政治，并揭示贩毒集团与美墨两国安全政策的复杂博弈。值得一读，因为它不仅是一则黑帮新闻，更是理解墨西哥毒品战争新阶段的关键窗口。
items.summary_en: In 2024, the Sinaloa cartel erupted into infighting when the son of Joaquín 'El Chapo' Guzmán kidnapped his father's co-founder and handed him over to US authorities. This betrayal ignited a brutal power struggle within the cartel, plunging the Mexican state of Sinaloa into a spiral of violence. This article deeply analyzes how the civil war is tearing apart local society, impacting geopolitics, and revealing the complex game between drug cartels and US-Mexico security policies. It is worth reading because it is not just a gangland story but a key window into a new phase of Mexico's drug war.

items.title_cn: “止血”：共和党人敦促特朗普禁止美国柴油出口
items.title_en: 'Stop the bleeding': Republicans tell Trump to ban US diesel exports
items.summary_cn: 伊朗战争引发的燃料价格危机正冲击美国农村腹地，共和党议员罕见地向特朗普施压，要求其禁止柴油出口以平抑国内油价。这一动向值得关注：它暴露了地缘冲突对能源供应链的传导效应，也显示特朗普在党内面临来自农业州的基本盘压力。若禁令落地，将重塑全球柴油贸易格局，并可能加剧与盟友的摩擦。
items.summary_en: The fuel price crisis triggered by the Iran war is hitting rural America's heartlands, prompting Republican lawmakers to unusually pressure Trump to ban diesel exports to curb domestic prices. This is worth watching: it exposes how geopolitical conflict transmits through energy supply chains and shows Trump facing pressure from his agricultural base within his own party. If enacted, the ban would reshape global diesel trade flows and could heighten friction with allies.

items.title_cn: 特朗普施压泽连斯基停止袭击俄罗斯炼油厂
items.title_en: Trump presses Zelenskyy to stop hitting Russian refineries
items.summary_cn: 据官员透露，美国总统特朗普在与乌克兰总统泽连斯基的通话中，明确要求乌方停止对俄罗斯炼油厂的打击，并强调“柴油、柴油、柴油”是关键。这一施压凸显了全球能源市场尤其是柴油供应对美国国内政治与经济稳定的重要性，也反映出特朗普政府试图避免因油价波动而影响选民情绪。值得关注的是，此举可能削弱乌克兰对俄能源基础设施的打击能力，同时暴露美国在支持乌克兰与维护自身能源利益之间的微妙平衡。
items.summary_en: According to officials, US President Trump explicitly demanded that Ukraine stop striking Russian oil refineries during a phone call with Ukrainian President Zelenskyy, stressing that it is all about 'diesel, diesel, diesel.' This pressure highlights the critical importance of global energy markets, especially diesel supply, to US domestic politics and economic stability, and reflects the Trump administration's attempt to avoid voter backlash from oil price fluctuations. Notably, this move could weaken Ukraine's ability to strike Russian energy infrastructure while exposing the delicate balance between US support for Ukraine and its own energy interests.

items.title_cn: OpenAI加入呼吁制定美国主导的全球AI标准
items.title_en: OpenAI joins call for US-led global AI standards
items.summary_cn: OpenAI首席执行官萨姆·奥尔特曼本周将向联合国安理会作简报，此前该公司因安全问题引发外界强烈担忧。此举表明，在人工智能监管缺位的背景下，美国科技巨头正试图主导全球AI规则制定，以缓解国际社会对AI风险的焦虑。值得关注的是，这反映出AI安全治理已从技术议题上升为地缘政治博弈，美国希望借联合国平台输出自身标准，而OpenAI则试图在监管浪潮中抢占话语先机。
items.summary_en: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman will brief the UN Security Council this week following outcry over safety concerns. This move indicates that, amid a regulatory vacuum, US tech giants are seeking to lead global AI rule-making to ease international anxiety over AI risks. Notably, AI safety governance has escalated from a technical issue to a geopolitical contest, with the US aiming to export its standards via the UN platform, while OpenAI seeks to seize the narrative initiative amid a wave of regulation.

items.title_cn: 英国首相伯纳姆呼吁全球合作应对AI威胁，将在联合国大会首次会晤特朗普
items.title_en: Burnham to call for global effort to control threats posed by AI
items.summary_cn: 英国首相伯纳姆将在纽约联合国大会期间与美国总统特朗普首次面对面会晤，并借此平台呼吁全球协同应对人工智能带来的安全威胁。此举凸显AI治理已上升为大国首脑直接对话的核心议题，值得关注的是，英美领导人能否在AI风险管控上形成共识，将影响未来全球科技监管格局。
items.summary_en: UK Prime Minister Burnham will meet US President Donald Trump in person for the first time at the UN General Assembly in New York, using the platform to call for a global effort to address security threats posed by AI. This highlights AI governance as a core topic in direct leader-level dialogue, and whether the UK and US can build consensus on AI risk control will shape the future landscape of global tech regulation.

items.title_cn: 苹果零售店缔造者不看好硅谷的AI购物赌注
items.title_en: The man who built Apple’s stores doesn’t buy Silicon Valley’s bet on AI shopping
items.summary_cn: 苹果零售店前负责人Ron Johnson公开质疑硅谷当前对AI购物的狂热押注。他认为，苹果零售的成功秘诀始终是“人”——店员与顾客的互动、体验和服务，而非技术本身。Johnson的观点为当下AI改造零售的浪潮提供了冷静反思：自动化与算法推荐能否真正替代人际连接？在追求效率的同时，零售业是否忽视了体验与信任的核心价值？这篇内容值得关注，因为它来自一手打造全球最成功零售体系的人，其判断对科技与零售从业者具有重要参考意义。
items.summary_en: Ron Johnson, the former head of Apple Retail, publicly questions Silicon Valley's current enthusiasm for AI-driven shopping. He argues that Apple's retail success has always come from its people—the interactions, experiences, and service provided by staff—not from technology itself. Johnson's perspective offers a sobering counterpoint to the rush of AI transformation in retail: can automation and algorithmic recommendations truly replace human connection? In the pursuit of efficiency, is retail neglecting the core value of experience and trust? This piece is worth reading because it comes from the person who built the world's most successful retail operation, and his judgment carries significant weight for both tech and retail professionals.

items.title_cn: OpenAI成立数学顾问小组，其AI已解决超100个开放问题
items.title_en: OpenAI forms math advisory group as its AI resolves more than 100 open problems
items.summary_cn: OpenAI宣布成立数学顾问小组，背景是其AI模型已成功解决超过100个数学开放问题。值得关注的是，该小组无权减缓或改变OpenAI正在进行的数学研究，这凸显了AI在数学发现中的加速作用与治理张力。此举既是对AI数学能力的认可，也引发对研究自主性与安全监督平衡的思考。
items.summary_en: OpenAI has announced the formation of a math advisory group, following its AI models having resolved more than 100 open problems in mathematics. Notably, the group will not be given leeway to slow down or redirect OpenAI's ongoing mathematical research, highlighting both the accelerating role of AI in mathematical discovery and the tension around governance. This move acknowledges AI's mathematical prowess while raising questions about balancing research autonomy and safety oversight.

items.title_cn: TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 门票优惠倒计时5天：最高省200美元，第二张半价
items.title_en: Discover what’s next: 5 days left to save up to $200 on your TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 ticket
items.summary_cn: TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 将于10月13-15日在旧金山 Moscone West 举行，预计汇聚超过10,000名创始人、投资人和运营者。当前购票可享受最高200美元优惠，且第二张票享5折，但优惠将于9月25日太平洋时间晚11:59截止。对于关注AI科技与创投生态的从业者而言，这是以更低成本参与全球顶级科技盛会、获取前沿趋势与拓展人脉的难得窗口期，建议尽早锁定席位。
items.summary_en: TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 will take place October 13–15 at Moscone West in San Francisco, bringing together more than 10,000 founders, investors, and operators. Right now, you can save up to $200 on a pass and get 50% off a second one, but the deal ends September 25 at 11:59 p.m. PT. For anyone tracking AI technology and the venture ecosystem, this is a rare window to attend a top global tech event at a lower cost, gain early insight into emerging trends, and expand your network—so it’s worth locking in your ticket soon.

items.title_cn: Meta的Muse在移动端早期上线表现超越ChatGPT
items.title_en: Meta’s Muse is outpacing ChatGPT’s early mobile launch
items.summary_cn: 据Appfigures最新估算，Meta新推出的AI代理Muse在美国和加拿大的下载量及日活跃用户数，均超过了ChatGPT移动端上线同期表现。这一数据表明Meta在AI消费级市场的快速渗透能力可能正在改变竞争格局，值得关注其后续留存与商业化潜力。
items.summary_en: According to new estimates from Appfigures, Meta's newly launched AI agent Muse has surpassed ChatGPT's early mobile performance in both downloads and daily active users in the U.S. and Canada. This suggests Meta's rapid consumer adoption in AI could be shifting the competitive landscape, making its retention and monetization potential worth watching.

items.title_cn: Meta的AI代理被亚马逊封禁，科技巨头生态壁垒再现
items.title_en: Meta’s AI agent has been blocked from using Amazon.com
items.summary_cn: 亚马逊拒绝Meta的AI代理Muse访问其平台，引发对科技巨头间AI生态封闭化的关注。亚马逊拥有自研基础模型和主流推理平台，在无法律义务的情况下，选择不向竞争对手开放。此举揭示了AI时代平台封锁的新趋势：掌握入口的巨头正利用其优势遏制对手，AI代理的跨平台互操作性面临严峻挑战。值得关注的是，这种封闭策略可能阻碍AI创新，并引发监管介入。
items.summary_en: Amazon has blocked Meta's AI agent Muse from accessing its platform, raising concerns about the increasing closure of AI ecosystems among tech giants. With its own foundation models and a leading inference platform, Amazon has no legal obligation to open its doors to a competitor. This move highlights a new trend of platform blocking in the AI era: gatekeepers are leveraging their advantages to stifle rivals, posing serious challenges to cross-platform interoperability for AI agents. This closed strategy could hinder AI innovation and invite regulatory scrutiny.

items.title_cn: 前会计师创办Tabby，用AI让会计师失业
items.title_en: With Tabby, a former accountant is using AI to make accountants obsolete
items.summary_cn: 一名前会计师创立了Tabby，一款实时记账界面，能在处理客户票据的同时提供最新的盈亏数据。这一工具直击传统记账痛点：人工处理滞后、成本高、易出错。Tabby用AI自动化基础账务，让企业主实时掌握财务状况，可能大幅压缩低端会计岗位需求。值得关注的是，它并非简单替代，而是将记账从周期性劳动变为持续服务，或将重塑中小企业的财务工作流。
items.summary_en: A former accountant founded Tabby, a real-time bookkeeping interface that processes clients' paperwork while providing up-to-the-minute profit and loss data. This tool directly addresses traditional bookkeeping pain points: manual processing delays, high costs, and error-proneness. Tabby uses AI to automate basic accounting, enabling business owners to track finances in real time and potentially slashing demand for low-end accounting roles. Notably, it doesn't just replace—it transforms bookkeeping from periodic labor into continuous service, likely reshaping financial workflows for small and medium businesses.

items.title_cn: 下一个突破性创业公司来自哪里？Benchmark全体合伙人在TechCrunch Disrupt 2026主舞台分享洞见
items.title_en: Where will the next breakout startup come from? Benchmark’s full partnership weighs in at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026
items.summary_cn: 本文预告了TechCrunch Disrupt 2026大会的重磅环节：顶级风投Benchmark全体合伙人将罕见同台，探讨下一个颠覆性创业公司将诞生于哪个领域。Benchmark以早期投资Uber、Twitter等巨头闻名，其全体合伙人的集体判断往往预示着科技投资的风向标。对于创业者、投资人和科技从业者而言，这是洞察未来创新趋势、把握早期机会的绝佳窗口。文章还提醒读者在9月25日前注册可节省200美元，兼具信息价值与行动指引。
items.summary_en: This article previews a highlight of TechCrunch Disrupt 2026: the full partnership of top-tier venture capital firm Benchmark will take the main stage together in a rare appearance to discuss where the next breakout startup will emerge. Benchmark is renowned for early investments in giants like Uber and Twitter, and the collective judgment of its partners often signals the direction of tech investment. For entrepreneurs, investors, and tech professionals, this is a prime opportunity to gain insight into future innovation trends and early-stage opportunities. The article also reminds readers that registering before September 25 can save up to $200, combining informational value with actionable guidance.

items.title_cn: 谷歌899美元Googlebook：押注你为Gemini买新笔记本
items.title_en: Google’s $899 Googlebook is a bet that you’ll buy a new laptop for Gemini
items.summary_cn: 谷歌推出售价899美元的AI原生笔记本Googlebook，将Gemini深度整合到光标、听写、小组件等桌面交互的方方面面。这不仅是硬件发布，更是谷歌对“AI即操作系统”的一次豪赌：它试图让Gemini成为用户与电脑之间的默认中介，而非附加功能。值得关注的是，谷歌能否借此打破Windows和macOS的垄断，以及用户是否愿意为AI体验支付溢价。
items.summary_en: Google has launched the $899 AI-native Googlebook, deeply integrating Gemini into the cursor, dictation, widgets, and other aspects of the desktop experience. This is not just a hardware release but a bold bet on 'AI as the operating system': it aims to make Gemini the default intermediary between users and their computers, rather than an add-on feature. The key questions are whether Google can break the Windows and macOS duopoly, and whether users are willing to pay a premium for an AI-first experience.

items.title_cn: 美国耗资数十亿建边境"虚拟墙"，为何仍无法阻止移民死亡？
items.title_en: The Download: investigating deaths at the US border's "virtual wall"
items.summary_cn: MIT科技评论历时15个月调查发现，美国边境部署了近600座配备AI摄像头和自动追踪系统的监控塔，却未能有效拯救越境者生命。2024年4月，32岁的Morales在距最近监控塔仅360英尺处因"环境暴露"死亡，遗体由垃圾场工人而非边境巡逻队发现。调查将近4000处遗骸发现地点与监控塔位置比对后揭示：这场人道主义危机恰恰发生在政府摄像头眼皮底下。本文深度剖析"虚拟墙"的技术失灵与制度困境，值得关注AI监控伦理与边境政策的人士阅读。
items.summary_en: A 15-month MIT Technology Review investigation reveals that the US has deployed nearly 600 AI-equipped surveillance towers along its border, yet failed to save lives. In April 2024, 32-year-old Morales died just 360 feet from the nearest tower, found by landfill workers rather than Border Patrol. By mapping nearly 4,000 remains recovery sites against tower locations, the investigation shows a humanitarian crisis unfolding in full view of government cameras. This in-depth analysis of the "virtual wall's" technological and institutional failures is essential reading for those concerned with AI surveillance ethics and border policy.

items.title_cn: 我们如何绘制出美国边境“虚拟墙”沿线死亡的首张全面地图
items.title_en: How we made the first comprehensive map of deaths along the US border’s “virtual wall”
items.summary_cn: MIT科技评论与圣地亚哥时报历时15个月调查，首次绘制出美墨边境监控塔附近移民死亡的综合地图。调查始于一个简单问题：为何如此多的人死在旨在追踪和逮捕他们的政府监控塔附近？团队查阅数千页政府文件、多次实地探访、采访45余人，包括白宫顾问、边境巡逻队员、法医、人道志愿者等。这份数据揭示了边境监控技术的失败，并还原了边境地带死亡者的故事，对理解技术伦理与边境政策具有重要价值。
items.summary_en: A 15-month investigation by MIT Technology Review and Times of San Diego produced the first comprehensive map of migrant deaths near US-Mexico border surveillance towers. It began with a simple question: Why do so many people die near government towers meant to track and apprehend them? The team reviewed thousands of pages of government documents, visited the border multiple times, and interviewed over 45 people, including White House advisors, Border Patrol agents, medical examiners, humanitarian volunteers, and tech employees. The data reveals failures of border surveillance technology and uncovers the stories of those who die in the borderlands, offering critical insight into tech ethics and border policy.

items.title_cn: 美墨边境“虚拟墙”失灵：AI监控塔为何未能阻止死亡悲剧？
items.title_en: 4 ways to address the failures we found along the US border’s “virtual wall”
items.summary_cn: MIT科技评论调查发现，美墨边境的AI监控塔存在系统性缺陷：设备故障、算法漏检、警报无人响应，导致多名移民在监控区域内死亡且数周至数月未被发现。随着美国政府计划投入10亿美元将虚拟墙规模扩大三倍，Anduril等国防承包商持续获得大单，这些失败案例却未引发足够警觉。本文提出四项改革建议，揭示技术监控背后的伦理与安全漏洞，值得所有关注AI治理与边境政策的人深思。
items.summary_en: An MIT Technology Review investigation reveals systemic failures in the US-Mexico border's AI-powered surveillance towers: broken equipment, algorithms that miss people, and unresponsive agents, leading to deaths that go unnoticed for weeks or months. As the US plans to spend $1 billion to triple the virtual wall by 2034—with defense contractor Anduril poised to benefit—these failures have yet to trigger adequate alarms. The article offers four recommendations, exposing critical ethical and safety gaps in tech-driven border enforcement that demand attention from anyone concerned with AI governance and immigration policy.

items.title_cn: 美国耗资数十亿建边境监控，为何仍无法阻止移民死亡？
items.title_en: The US spent billions on border surveillance. Why can’t it catch people before they die?
items.summary_cn: 2024年4月，32岁的莫拉莱斯穿越新墨西哥州沙漠时，虽处于三座AI监控塔范围内，却仍未被及时发现并获救。这些由Anduril制造的监控塔配备摄像头和AI，可自动检测并追踪人员，实时传输视频并通知附近探员。然而，这套耗资数十亿的系统却未能阻止悲剧发生。MIT科技评论与圣地亚哥时报联合调查，揭露边境监控技术的失败，以及那些命丧边境者的故事。
items.summary_en: In April 2024, 32-year-old Morales crossed the New Mexico desert within range of three AI-powered surveillance towers, yet was not detected and rescued in time. Built by Anduril, these towers use cameras and AI to automatically detect and track people, stream live video, and alert nearby agents. But the billion-dollar system failed to prevent tragedy. A joint investigation by MIT Technology Review and Times of San Diego exposes the failures of border surveillance technology and the stories of those who die in the borderlands.

items.title_cn: 她死在圣地亚哥边境，监控摄像头就在眼前
items.title_en: She died at the San Diego border. A surveillance camera was in plain sight
items.summary_cn: 2025年9月，30岁的墨西哥移民Graciela Gómez Hernández在穿越圣地亚哥边境后迷失于Otay山区，最终死亡。令人震惊的是，一个监控摄像头就在她死亡地点附近，却未能挽救她的生命。MIT Technology Review与Times of San Diego联合调查发现，边境监控技术存在严重缺陷，这些耗资巨大的系统不仅未能有效阻止非法越境，也未能及时救援陷入困境的移民。本文通过一个母亲的悲剧，揭示了边境监控体系的人道主义危机与技术失灵，值得深思。
items.summary_en: In September 2025, 30-year-old Mexican migrant Graciela Gómez Hernández died after getting lost in the Otay Mountain Wilderness after crossing the San Diego border. Shockingly, a surveillance camera was in plain sight near where she died but failed to save her. A joint investigation by MIT Technology Review and Times of San Diego reveals serious failures in border surveillance technology: these costly systems not only fail to effectively prevent illegal crossings but also fail to rescue migrants in distress. Through the tragedy of a mother, this story exposes the humanitarian crisis and technological dysfunction of the border surveillance system, and is worth deep reflection.

items.title_cn: AI真的会灭绝人类吗？生物武器威胁敲响警钟
items.title_en: The Download: AI's extinction risk and bioweapons threat
items.summary_cn: 本期MIT科技评论《The Download》聚焦AI的生存风险与生物武器威胁。针对公众最关心的“AI会不会杀死我们”等问题，资深编辑给出了直接回应，并指出AI辅助设计生物武器的门槛已低得惊人。文章不仅剖析了AI被用于制造灾难的真实可能性，还探讨了监管与控制的可行路径。对于想了解AI安全边界与生物技术风险交叉点的读者，这是一份不容错过的清醒指南。
items.summary_en: This edition of MIT Technology Review's The Download focuses on AI's existential risk and bioweapons threat. Addressing the public's most pressing question—'Could AI really kill us all?'—senior editors offer direct answers and reveal how alarmingly easy it is to use AI to design bioweapons. The piece examines the real potential for AI-driven catastrophe and explores feasible paths for regulation and control. For anyone seeking clarity on the intersection of AI safety and biotech risks, this is an essential wake-up call.

items.title_cn: AI真会灭掉人类吗？你关心的几个问题，答案来了
items.title_en: Could AI really kill us all? Your questions, answered.
items.summary_cn: MIT Technology Review举办订阅者圆桌活动，探讨“AI是否会杀死我们所有人”。因30分钟远远不够，资深AI编辑Will Douglas Heaven与记者Grace Huckins整理并回答了观众最尖锐的问题。文章直面“我会死吗”这一终极焦虑，指出AI无人机已在乌克兰夺命、针对医院的AI网络攻击或将很快造成伤亡，而AI导致人类灭绝虽可能性较低，但连年预警的“末日论者”对AI能力与对齐的判断已惊人应验。值得一读，因为它把科幻恐惧拉回现实风险，又保留了对极端场景的清醒警惕。
items.summary_en: MIT Technology Review hosted a live Roundtables event for subscribers asking the question everyone is asking: Could AI really kill us all? With only 30 minutes and far more questions than answers, senior AI editor Will Douglas Heaven and AI reporter Grace Huckins rounded up the best audience questions and answered them. The piece confronts the ultimate anxiety—'Am I gonna die?'—noting that AI-powered drones have already killed in Ukraine and AI-driven cyberattacks on hospitals will likely claim victims soon. While AI wiping out humanity is less likely, the doomers' predictions about AI capabilities and alignment have proved disconcertingly accurate. A must-read for grounding sci-fi fears in real risks while staying alert to extreme scenarios.

items.title_cn: AI生物武器的幽灵：生物技术行业的警钟已敲响
items.title_en: The specter of AI-enabled bioweapons is a wake-up call for biotech
items.summary_cn: AI公司领袖罕见集体发声，承认自己开发的技术可能带来灭绝级风险。Anthropic与OpenAI高管公开讨论AI协助制造生物武器的可能性，甚至有研究员给出十年内超10%的灭绝概率。文章揭示了一个令人不安的实验：AI分子生成器仅用不到六小时就产出四万种潜在化学战剂。这不是科幻，而是生物技术行业必须立即正视的治理危机。
items.summary_en: Leaders of major AI companies are openly warning that the technology they are building could pose an existential threat. Executives from Anthropic and OpenAI have publicly discussed the risk of AI aiding the creation of bioweapons, with one researcher putting the odds of human extinction within a decade at over 10%. The article highlights a disturbing experiment in which an AI molecule generator produced 40,000 potential chemical warfare agents in under six hours. This is not science fiction but a governance crisis the biotech industry must confront now.

items.title_cn: 加州收紧AI数据中心能耗与用水监管，科技巨头不能再把成本转嫁给居民
items.title_en: California tightens rules on AI data center energy and water use
items.summary_cn: 加州州长纽森签署七项法案，针对AI数据中心出台全美最全面监管：要求公用事业委员会为数据中心设立新费率类别，强制其承担电网和水系统升级费用，并公开预估用水量、能效及抗旱规划。此举直击AI扩张背后的资源外部性问题——数据中心消耗巨量电力和水资源，却长期由普通居民分摊成本。在联邦层面监管缺位的背景下，加州为各州提供了可复制的治理模板，值得关注AI产业与公共资源冲突的读者细读。
items.summary_en: California Gov. Gavin Newsom signed seven bills enacting the nation's most comprehensive AI data center regulations: the CPUC must create a new rate class for data centers, forcing them to pay for power grid and water system upgrades, and disclose estimated water use, energy efficiency, and drought planning. The laws target a core externality of AI expansion—data centers consume enormous electricity and water while residents shoulder the costs. With federal inaction, California offers a replicable governance model for other states, making this essential reading for anyone tracking the collision between AI growth and public resources.

items.title_cn: 约翰·特努斯能否为苹果找到下一个大事件？
items.title_en: Can John Ternus find Apple’s next big thing?
items.summary_cn: 本文是The Verge对彭博社首席苹果记者马克·古尔曼的专访。古尔曼提前曝光了苹果年度iPhone硬件发布会的几乎所有细节，而这场发布会意义特殊：这是新任CEO约翰·特努斯接替蒂姆·库克后不到两周内的首场重大产品发布，也是苹果首款折叠屏手机iPhone Duo的亮相。文章深入探讨了苹果硬件发布会背后的叙事逻辑、库克过去一年对领导层的大规模调整，以及这些变动如何影响苹果文化，进而揭示特努斯计划如何带领苹果从“iPhone时代”过渡到“AI时代”。对于关注苹果战略转型与AI布局的读者，这篇访谈提供了来自最可靠信源的独家洞察。
items.summary_en: This is The Verge's interview with Mark Gurman, Bloomberg's chief Apple correspondent. Gurman had reported virtually every detail of Apple's annual iPhone hardware event ahead of time, and this event was particularly significant: it was new CEO John Ternus' first major product launch less than two weeks after succeeding Tim Cook, and it marked the debut of the iPhone Duo, Apple's first foldable smartphone. The article explores the narrative logic behind Apple's hardware events, Cook's wholesale leadership changes over the past year, and how these shifts might reshape Apple's culture—revealing Ternus' plan to navigate Apple from the iPhone era into the AI era. For readers tracking Apple's strategic transformation and AI ambitions, this interview offers exclusive insights from the best-sourced reporter in the field.

items.title_cn: 苹果2.5亿美元Siri AI和解案开放索赔，符合条件的iPhone用户可申请赔偿
items.title_en: iPhone owners can now submit claims in Apple's $250 million Siri AI settlement
items.summary_cn: 苹果因未能兑现AI升级版Siri的承诺，同意支付2.5亿美元和解集体诉讼。2024年6月10日至2025年3月29日期间购买iPhone 15 Pro、15 Pro Max或任意iPhone 16机型的美国用户，现可通过和解网站提交索赔。每台符合条件的设备预计可获约25美元，若索赔人数较少，单台最高可达95美元。此案揭示了科技巨头在AI营销宣传与产品实际交付之间的落差，也提醒消费者关注自身权益，值得关注AI产品承诺兑现与法律责任的边界。
items.summary_en: Apple has agreed to pay $250 million to settle a class-action lawsuit alleging it failed to deliver the AI-upgraded Siri it promised. US customers who purchased an iPhone 15 Pro, iPhone 15 Pro Max, or any iPhone 16 model between June 10, 2024, and March 29, 2025 can now file a claim on the settlement website. Eligible devices are estimated to receive about $25 each, though that could rise to as much as $95 depending on how many claims are filed. The case highlights the gap between Big Tech's AI marketing promises and actual product delivery, and serves as a reminder for consumers to stay informed about their rights — making it a noteworthy story about accountability in the AI era.

items.title_cn: 联合国警告：AI安全防护不能等待风险完全确定
items.title_en: UN says AI safeguards can't wait for certainty
items.summary_cn: 联合国科学小组发布首份重大评估，警告各国政府必须在AI代理风险被完全理解之前采取监管行动。报告援引OpenAI今年早些时候对Hugging Face的入侵事件，强调AI已进入全球外交议程核心。秘书长古特雷斯呼吁各国合作应对AI威胁，警告世界无法承受AI安全底线竞争。这份报告值得关注，因为它标志着联合国首次就AI代理失调风险发出系统性警示，并可能推动全球AI治理框架的加速形成。
items.summary_en: A UN scientific panel has issued its first major assessment, warning that governments must regulate AI agents before their risks are fully understood. The report cites OpenAI's hack of Hugging Face earlier this year, stressing that AI is now central to global diplomacy. Secretary-General António Guterres called on governments to cooperate on AI threats, warning the world cannot afford a race to the bottom on AI safety. This report is worth watching because it marks the UN's first systematic warning on AI agent misalignment risks and could accelerate the formation of a global AI governance framework.

items.title_cn: 亚马逊封禁Meta的Muse AI代理，代理式购物引发平台主权之争
items.title_en: Amazon blocks Meta's Muse AI agent
items.summary_cn: 亚马逊封禁了Meta的Muse AI代理，阻止其代用户在其平台上购物，理由是未经授权的AI代理违反使用条款，并引发隐私与安全担忧。Meta未提前通知亚马逊，且Muse在浏览时未表明身份、疑似获取用户凭证。此事标志着平台与AI代理之间围绕“代理式购物”控制权的正面冲突，值得关注：它可能决定未来AI助手能否跨平台代购，以及电商平台如何捍卫自身流量与数据主权。
items.summary_en: Amazon has blocked Meta's Muse AI agent from shopping on its platform on behalf of users, citing violations of its Conditions of Use by an unauthorized AI agent, as well as privacy and security concerns. Meta reportedly did not notify Amazon about Muse's access, and the agent failed to identify itself while browsing and seemingly captured customer credentials. This marks a direct clash between platforms and AI agents over control of 'agentic shopping,' and is worth watching because it may determine whether future AI assistants can make cross-platform purchases, and how e-commerce platforms defend their traffic and data sovereignty.

items.title_cn: 英伟达黄仁勋称AI恐惧被夸大，没人感到意外
items.title_en: No one is surprised that Nvidia's Jensen Huang thinks AI fears are overblown
items.summary_cn: 英伟达CEO黄仁勋在CBS采访中称AI毁灭世界的概率为0%，认为恐吓公众不负责任，并反驳Anthropic和OpenAI CEO的放缓呼吁缺乏科学依据。作为AI热潮最大受益者，黄仁勋的立场与其商业利益高度一致，此番言论引发对利益冲突与AI安全讨论的重新审视。
items.summary_en: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang told CBS there is a '0% chance' AI will end the world, calling fearmongering irresponsible and dismissing calls from Anthropic and OpenAI CEOs to slow development as 'not grounded in science.' As the biggest beneficiary of the AI boom, Huang's stance aligns with his commercial interests, raising questions about conflicts of interest and the future of AI safety debates.

items.title_cn: 特朗普宣布组建“AI力量”并任命AI沙皇，承诺不阻碍AI发展
items.title_en: Trump now says he wants to form an ‘AI Force’
items.summary_cn: 特朗普在Truth Social上宣布将任命“AI沙皇”领导新的“AI力量”，并承诺不阻碍AI行业发展。此举正值各界呼吁放缓AI开发之际，其言论与行业审慎趋势形成鲜明对比，值得关注其对AI监管走向的潜在影响。
items.summary_en: Trump announced on Truth Social that he would appoint an 'AI czar' to lead a new 'AI Force' and pledged not to hinder the AI industry's growth. This comes amid growing calls to slow down AI development, contrasting with the industry's cautious trend and warranting attention for its potential impact on AI regulation.

items.title_cn: 人类而非失控AI，仍是能源系统最大的网络安全风险
items.title_en: Humans, not rogue AI, are still the biggest cybersecurity risk to energy systems
items.summary_cn: 在近期备受瞩目的黑客攻击引发AI可能“消灭人类”的恐慌之前，能源系统早已在网络安全面前不堪一击，且风险持续加剧。安全与技术研究所的Joshua Corman曾指出，能源系统一直是“猎物”，只是侥幸在捕食者的胃口下苟存。本文通过对话Corman，探讨近期失控AI事件与能源基础设施面临的真实威胁，揭示为何人类因素而非AI本身才是当前最紧迫的安全漏洞。
items.summary_en: Before recent high-profile hacks raised the specter of AI possibly 'killing all humans,' energy systems were already disturbingly vulnerable to cyberattack—and the risk is growing. Joshua Corman of the Institute for Security and Technology noted that energy systems have always been prey, merely surviving at the appetite of predators. This article discusses recent rogue AI incidents and the real threats to energy infrastructure, revealing why human factors, not AI itself, remain the most pressing security gap.

items.title_cn: 马丁·艾米斯：一份赏析
items.title_en: Martin Amis: An Appreciation
items.summary_cn: 这篇赏析深入探讨了马丁·艾米斯2007年的创作与思想状态，捕捉了他作为当代英语文学巨匠的独特声音。文章不仅回顾了艾米斯对语言、道德与时代的犀利洞察，还揭示了他如何在小说与随笔中持续挑战读者的智识边界。对于理解艾米斯晚期风格及其文学遗产而言，这是一份兼具敬意与批判性的珍贵导览，值得每一位关注战后英国文学演变的读者细读。
items.summary_en: This appreciation delves into Martin Amis's creative and intellectual state in 2007, capturing the distinctive voice of a major figure in contemporary English literature. It revisits Amis's sharp insights into language, morality, and his era, while revealing how he continued to challenge readers' intellectual boundaries in both fiction and essays. For anyone seeking to understand Amis's late style and literary legacy, this is a valuable guide that combines respect with critical scrutiny—essential reading for those interested in the evolution of postwar British literature.

items.title_cn: 书评：《NB by J.C.》，詹姆斯·坎贝尔著
items.title_en: Book Review: ‘NB by J.C.,’ by James Campbell
items.summary_cn: 本书收录了詹姆斯·坎贝尔在《泰晤士文学增刊》上撰写的专栏文章，以其广博的学识和敏锐的洞察力，勾勒出文学界的众生相。坎贝尔的随笔风格独特，既有对作家轶事的生动叙述，也有对文学潮流的深刻反思，字里行间透露出对书籍与写作的挚爱。对于热爱文学批评与随笔的读者而言，这部合集不仅是一份智识的盛宴，更是一扇窥见二十世纪末至二十一世纪初文学现场的重要窗口，值得细细品味。
items.summary_en: This book collects James Campbell's columns from the Times Literary Supplement, offering a wide-ranging and insightful portrait of the literary world. Campbell's essays are distinctive in style, combining lively anecdotes about writers with profound reflections on literary trends, all infused with a deep love for books and writing. For readers who cherish literary criticism and essays, this collection is not only an intellectual feast but also a vital window into the literary scene from the late twentieth to the early twenty-first century, deserving careful savoring.

items.title_cn: 在《黑暗中的火焰》中，凯·雷德菲尔德·贾米森转向疗愈者
items.title_en: In ‘Fires in the Dark,’ Kay Redfield Jamison Turns to Healers
items.summary_cn: 凯·雷德菲尔德·贾米森曾以自身精神疾病经历写作，改变了许多人的生活，却也遭遇大量拒绝。在新书《黑暗中的火焰》中，她将目光转向疗愈者——那些在绝望中点燃希望的人。这本书不仅延续了她对躁郁症与创造力的深刻洞察，更探索了治疗、共情与人性联结的力量。贾米森以科学家的严谨与诗人的笔触，追问：是什么让一些人能够帮助他人穿越黑暗？对于任何关注心理健康、创伤与复原力的读者，这是一部不可多得的启示之作。
items.summary_en: When Kay Redfield Jamison started to write about her own experiences with mental illness, she met people who felt her writing had changed their lives. She also received a lot of rejection. In her new book, 'Fires in the Dark,' she turns to healers—those who ignite hope in despair. This book not only continues her profound insights into bipolar disorder and creativity but also explores the power of treatment, empathy, and human connection. With a scientist's rigor and a poet's touch, Jamison asks: What enables some people to help others through the darkness? For anyone concerned with mental health, trauma, and resilience, this is a rare and revelatory work.

items.title_cn: 侦探小说《谁的尸体？》百年诞辰：多萝西·L·塞耶斯与推理黄金时代
items.title_en: The Detective Novel ‘Whose Body?,’ by Dorothy L. Sayers, Turns 100
items.summary_cn: 多萝西·L·塞耶斯的处女作《谁的尸体？》迎来百年诞辰。这部1923年出版的小说塑造了贵族侦探彼得·温西勋爵，并以幽默与思辨颠覆了传统侦探形象。塞耶斯参与创立侦探俱乐部，与阿加莎·克里斯蒂等人共同定义了推理黄金时代。本书不仅情节精巧，更探讨了罪与罚、阶级与道德，至今仍启发着对类型文学的严肃思考。为何一部百年前的侦探小说依然值得阅读？因为它证明了娱乐与深度可以并存。
items.summary_en: Dorothy L. Sayers's debut novel, 'Whose Body?,' turns 100. Published in 1923, it introduced Lord Peter Wimsey, an aristocratic detective whose wit and introspection upended the conventional sleuth. Sayers co-founded the Detection Club, helping define the Golden Age of detective fiction alongside Agatha Christie. The book is not only a clever puzzle but also a meditation on guilt, class, and morality, still inspiring serious thought about genre fiction. Why does a century-old detective novel remain worth reading? Because it proves entertainment and depth can coexist.

items.title_cn: 书评：《堂卡斯穆罗》，马查多·德·阿西斯著
items.title_en: Book Review: ‘Dom Casmurro,’ by Machado de Assis
items.summary_cn: 这部巴西文学经典以不可靠叙述者本托的回忆展开，讲述他与青梅竹马卡皮图的爱情与猜忌。马查多·德·阿西斯用精确细节与高超的模糊手法，迫使读者反复阅读、自行判断真相。小说不仅是对嫉妒与背叛的剖析，更是对叙事本身的一次革命性实验。值得看，因为它挑战你对事实与虚构的信任，让你在每一次重读中发现新的暗线。
items.summary_en: This Brazilian classic unfolds through the unreliable memories of Bento, who recounts his love and suspicion for his childhood sweetheart Capitu. Machado de Assis uses precise detail and masterly obfuscation to force readers to reread and judge for themselves. More than a study of jealousy and betrayal, it is a revolutionary experiment in narrative itself. Worth reading because it challenges your trust in fact and fiction, revealing new undercurrents with every reread.

items.title_cn: 书评：《晚来的人》，布兰登·泰勒著
items.title_en: Book Review: ‘The Late Americans,’ by Brandon Taylor
items.summary_cn: 布兰登·泰勒的新作《晚来的人》将镜头对准爱荷华城的居民——他们中有人享有特权，有人没有，但所有人都意识到自己的可能性正在收缩。小说以细腻笔触描绘这群人在理想与现实之间的挣扎，探讨阶级、欲望与艺术抱负的复杂交织。泰勒延续了《现实生活》中对边缘群体的关注，以冷静而克制的叙事，揭示当代美国年轻人面对未来日益狭窄时的焦虑与韧性。这部作品不仅是对特定社群的写照，更是对当代生存困境的深刻洞察，值得所有关注社会流动性与个体命运的读者细读。
items.summary_en: Brandon Taylor's new novel, 'The Late Americans,' turns its lens on the residents of Iowa City—some privileged, some not, but all aware that their possibilities are contracting. With delicate prose, the novel portrays this group's struggles between ideals and reality, exploring the complex interplay of class, desire, and artistic ambition. Taylor continues his focus on marginalized communities from 'Real Life,' using calm and restrained narration to reveal the anxiety and resilience of contemporary young Americans facing an increasingly narrowing future. This work is not only a portrait of a specific community but also a profound insight into the predicaments of contemporary existence, worthy of close reading by anyone concerned with social mobility and individual destiny.

items.title_cn: 马丁·艾米斯最佳书籍指南
items.title_en: Martin Amis’s Best Books: A Guide
items.summary_cn: 马丁·艾米斯于2012年在布鲁克林家中。他出版了15部小说，以其机智和语言创造力赢得赞誉。这份指南梳理了他最值得阅读的作品，帮助读者理解他如何以独特文体和黑色幽默剖析当代生活。无论是初次接触还是重温经典，都能从中获得选书指引与深层洞察。
items.summary_en: Martin Amis at his home in Brooklyn in 2012. He published 15 novels, which drew acclaim for their wit and linguistic ingenuity. This guide surveys his most essential works, helping readers understand how he dissected contemporary life with a distinctive style and dark humor. Whether you are new to his writing or revisiting it, the guide offers both reading recommendations and deeper insight.

items.title_cn: 2024年最佳浪漫小说（迄今）
items.title_en: The Best Romance Novels of 2024 (So Far)
items.summary_cn: 这份书单精选了2024年迄今最性感、最令人心动的浪漫小说，专为寻求逃离现实的读者打造。无论你偏爱甜蜜治愈还是火辣激情，这些作品都能带来沉浸式的爱情体验。编辑以敏锐眼光筛选出最具魅力的故事，让你在忙碌生活中找到片刻浪漫与慰藉。值得一看，因为每一本都经过精心挑选，确保情感张力与阅读快感并存。
items.summary_en: This list curates the sexiest and most swoon-worthy romance novels of 2024 so far, perfect for readers seeking an escapist love story. Whether you prefer sweet and healing or steamy and passionate, these books offer an immersive romantic experience. The editor's keen eye selects the most charming stories, letting you find a moment of romance and comfort in a busy life. Worth reading because each pick is carefully chosen to guarantee both emotional tension and reading pleasure.

items.title_cn: 肠道健康与减重的最佳工具 | Chris Thompson 博士
items.title_en: Best Tools for Gut Health & Weight Loss | Dr. Chris Thompson
items.summary_cn: 哈佛医学院教授、麻省总医院介入胃肠病学主任 Chris Thompson 博士，深入解析胃肠道如何调控饥饿感、饱腹感与血糖，以及肠道微生物组、代谢健康与减重的关联。内容涵盖常见胃肠问题的实用检测与干预、GLP-1 药物与非 GLP-1 减重路径的利弊、膳食纤维与发酵食品的作用、间歇性禁食对微生物组的影响等。无论你是否正面临肠道或体重困扰，这场对话都提供了极具实践价值的科学指导。
items.summary_en: Dr. Chris Thompson, MD, Professor of Medicine at Harvard Medical School and Chief of Interventional Gastroenterology at Mass General Brigham, explains how the GI tract regulates hunger, fullness, and blood sugar, along with the gut microbiome, metabolic health, and weight loss. The discussion covers practical tests and interventions for common GI issues, the benefits and limitations of GLP-1 medications versus non-GLP-1 approaches, the roles of fiber, resistant starch, and fermented foods, and how intermittent fasting affects the microbiome. This conversation offers practical, science-based guidance for anyone concerned about gut health or weight management.

items.title_cn: 必备指南：如何评估并提升身体素质的各个方面 | Andy Galpin 博士
items.title_en: Essentials: How to Assess & Improve All Aspects of Your Fitness | Dr. Andy Galpin
items.summary_cn: 本期 Huberman Lab  essentials 节目中，运动生理学家 Andy Galpin 博士系统讲解了身体素质的九大核心组成部分，并提供了实用的评估方法，包括握力、俯卧撑、VO2 max 等测试。无论你是想优化训练计划、追踪进步，还是明确优先提升的领域，这期内容都能为你提供科学、可操作的指导，帮助你实现长期健康与运动表现的双重目标。
items.summary_en: In this Huberman Lab Essentials episode, exercise physiologist Dr. Andy Galpin breaks down the nine major components of physical fitness and offers practical assessments, including grip strength, push-ups, and VO2 max tests. Whether you want to optimize your training, track progress, or identify priority areas, this episode provides science-based, actionable guidance to support long-term health and performance.

items.title_cn: 真正幸福的艺术 | 亚瑟·布鲁克斯博士
items.title_en: The Art of True Happiness | Dr. Arthur Brooks
items.summary_cn: 幸福并非玄学，而是可被拆解的科学。哈佛商学院高级研究员、幸福科学专家亚瑟·布鲁克斯博士提出构成真正幸福的三大“宏量营养素”：享受、满足与意义，并给出可操作的自我探索工具，帮助你识别阻碍自己获得幸福与目标感的真正原因。本视频超越泛泛的故事与观察，引导你发现什么对自己最重要，并据此重塑生活，从而收获更多喜悦与成就感。无论你正陷入迷茫、倦怠，还是渴望更深层的满足，这期内容都提供了清晰的思考框架与行动路径。
items.summary_en: Happiness is not mysticism but a science that can be broken down. Dr. Arthur Brooks, a senior fellow at Harvard Business School and an expert on the science of happiness, presents the three "macronutrients" of true happiness: enjoyment, satisfaction, and meaning, along with actionable self-discovery tools to help you identify what is truly blocking your access to happiness and a sense of purpose. Going beyond anecdotes and observations, this video guides you to discover what matters most to you and to reshape your life around those things, leading to more joy and fulfillment. Whether you are feeling lost, burned out, or yearning for deeper satisfaction, this content offers a clear framework for thinking and a path for action.

items.title_cn: 基因与跨代记忆遗传：小RNA如何改写遗传法则 | Oded Rechavi博士
items.title_en: Essentials: Genes & the Inheritance of Memories Across Generations | Dr. Oded Rechavi
items.summary_cn: 本视频邀请特拉维夫大学Oded Rechavi教授，深入探讨DNA、RNA与表观遗传机制如何决定代际间传递的遗传信息。节目挑战了“获得性性状不可遗传”的传统观点，通过秀丽隐杆线虫研究揭示小RNA能传递抗病毒能力并影响后代行为。内容涵盖从魏斯曼屏障到表观遗传重编程，再到哺乳动物与人类潜在应用，为理解遗传、记忆与生殖健康提供了颠覆性视角，值得对基因科学前沿感兴趣的观众一看。
items.summary_en: In this episode, Dr. Oded Rechavi, professor at Tel Aviv University, explores how DNA, RNA, and epigenetic mechanisms determine what information passes between generations. Challenging the traditional view that acquired traits are not inherited, he presents research in C. elegans showing that small RNAs can transmit antiviral resistance and influence behavior across generations. Covering the Weismann barrier, epigenetic reprogramming, and potential implications for mammals and human reproductive health, this discussion offers a groundbreaking perspective on genetics, memory, and inheritance—essential viewing for anyone interested in the frontiers of gene science.

items.title_cn: 线粒体如何掌控你的新陈代谢｜Jared Rutter博士
items.title_en: How Mitochondria Control Your Metabolism | Dr. Jared Rutter
items.summary_cn: 犹他大学生物化学教授、HHMI研究员Jared Rutter博士深入解析线粒体不仅是细胞的能量工厂，更关键地调控细胞生长与复制，从而深刻影响衰老、癌症及多种疾病。本期对话将新陈代谢理解为数万亿细胞的综合表现，并指出改善健康、预防和治疗疾病的新路径。如果你想理解代谢健康的底层逻辑，这期内容提供了前沿且系统的科学视角。
items.summary_en: Dr. Jared Rutter, Professor of Biochemistry at the University of Utah and HHMI Investigator, explains that mitochondria are not just the cell's power plants but also key regulators of cell growth and replication, profoundly influencing aging, cancer, and other diseases. This conversation frames metabolism as the composite of trillions of individual cells and points to new ways to improve health, avoid, and treat diseases. If you want to understand the fundamental logic of metabolic health, this episode offers a cutting-edge and systematic scientific perspective.

items.title_cn: 必备指南：利用睡眠提升学习、记忆力与情绪状态 | 吉娜·坡博士
items.title_en: Essentials: Use Sleep to Enhance Learning, Memory & Emotional State | Dr. Gina Poe
items.summary_cn: 本期Huberman Lab Essentials邀请UCLA整合生物学与生理学教授吉娜·坡博士，深入解析睡眠架构如何分阶段支持记忆巩固、创造力、大脑修复与情绪处理。内容涵盖生长激素与早睡的关系、酒精对睡眠的负面影响、REM睡眠与创伤恢复、睡眠纺锤波与学习能力等关键机制，并提供科学支持的改善睡眠质量、认知表现与激素平衡的实用工具。无论你是想优化学习效率、调节情绪，还是提升整体健康，这期节目都提供了基于神经科学的清晰行动指南。
items.summary_en: In this Huberman Lab Essentials episode, Dr. Gina Poe, PhD, Professor of Integrative Biology and Physiology at UCLA, explains how sleep architecture supports distinct functions including memory consolidation, creativity, brain restoration, and emotional processing. The discussion covers growth hormone and early sleep, alcohol's negative effects on sleep, REM sleep and trauma recovery, sleep spindles and learning, and offers science-supported tools to improve sleep quality, cognitive performance, and hormone balance. Whether you want to optimize learning, regulate emotions, or enhance overall health, this episode provides clear, neuroscience-based action steps.

items.title_cn: 如何加速学习并革新教育 | Joe Liemandt
items.title_en: How to Accelerate Learning & Improve Education | Joe Liemandt
items.summary_cn: 本视频中，Huberman Lab邀请Alpha School创始人Joe Liemandt，探讨如何利用AI和个性化学习，让学生在每天仅两小时内掌握学术知识，从而腾出时间发展创业、实验和社区参与等实用技能。对话涵盖传统课堂模式的历史、AI在掌握学习中的作用、工作记忆与流畅性、以及AI如何重塑教育潜力。对于关心教育创新、AI应用和儿童成长的观众，这是一次极具前瞻性和实操性的深度对话。
items.summary_en: In this episode of Huberman Lab, Joe Liemandt, founder of Alpha School, discusses how AI and individualized learning can help students master academics in just two hours a day, freeing time for entrepreneurship, experiments, and community engagement. The conversation covers the history of traditional classrooms, AI's role in mastery learning, working memory and fluency, and how AI could transform education and human potential. This is a forward-looking and practical discussion for anyone interested in education innovation, AI applications, and child development.

items.title_cn: essentials：饮食与营养如何影响心理健康 | Chris Palmer 博士
items.title_en: Essentials: Diet & Nutrition for Mental Health | Dr. Chris Palmer
items.summary_cn: 哈佛医学院精神病学助理教授 Chris Palmer 博士在 Huberman Lab Essentials 中深入解析营养与代谢如何直接作用于心理健康。他结合生物学机制，探讨低碳水饮食、生酮饮食和禁食如何改善情绪、能量，甚至对难治性精神疾病产生疗效。视频包含个人经历、精神分裂症成功案例及线粒体功能等关键内容，为理解饮食干预精神健康提供了前沿视角。
items.summary_en: In this Huberman Lab Essentials episode, Dr. Chris Palmer, MD, Assistant Professor of Psychiatry at Harvard Medical School, explains how nutrition and metabolism directly affect mental health through biological mechanisms. He discusses how carbohydrate restriction, ketogenic diets, and fasting can improve mood, energy, and even treatment-resistant psychiatric conditions. The episode includes personal stories, a schizophrenia success case, and insights into mitochondrial function, offering a cutting-edge perspective on dietary interventions for mental health.

items.title_cn: Ali Abdaal不拍YouTube视频时的一天：真实运营公司的幕后日常
items.title_en: What I Actually Do When I'm Not Making YouTube Videos
items.summary_cn: 这支Vlog记录了Ali Abdaal在香港办公室一个周五的真实工作日，揭开他「不拍视频时到底在做什么」的面纱。你会看到他如何为Lifestyle Business Academy学员主持两场周五炉边谈话、与Nathan的教练电话如何意外催生了新课程内容、他如何用「splurge」写作法撰写本周LifeNotes，以及一趟计划外的DJI门店之旅。对于好奇内容创作者如何转型为教育创业者、如何平衡内容输出与公司运营的观众来说，这支视频提供了一个难得的真实切片——没有精致剪辑，只有运营一家在线教育公司的琐碎与思考。
items.summary_en: This vlog captures a real Friday workday at Ali Abdaal's Hong Kong office, pulling back the curtain on what he actually does when he's not filming YouTube videos. You'll see him host two Friday fireside sessions for Lifestyle Business Academy students, watch a coaching call with Nathan accidentally turn into new curriculum, learn how he writes this week's LifeNotes using a technique called the splurge, and tag along on a slightly unplanned trip to the DJI store. For anyone curious about how a content creator transitions into an education entrepreneur and balances content output with running a company, this video offers a rare, unfiltered slice of reality—no polished editing, just the messiness and thinking behind running an online education business.

items.title_cn: 我曾以为冥想毫无意义，直到它彻底改变了我的专注力
items.title_en: I used to think meditation was pointless…
items.summary_cn: 作者曾对冥想持怀疑态度，认为它毫无用处，但通过Waking Up应用上的28天课程后，彻底改变了对思维和专注力的看法。核心洞察在于：决定生活质量的不是外部环境，而是我们的注意力。这一观点颠覆了常见的幸福认知，值得所有想提升专注力、改善内心状态的人一看。视频还提供了14天免费试用链接，适合想要亲身尝试的观众。
items.summary_en: The author once doubted meditation, thinking it was pointless, but after trying the 28-day course on the Waking Up app, their view of the mind and focus was completely transformed. The key insight: our quality of life is determined by our attention, not our external circumstances. This challenges common assumptions about happiness and is worth watching for anyone seeking to improve focus and inner well-being. A 14-day free trial link is also included for those who want to try it themselves.

items.title_cn: 我问了5位企业主：他们是如何获得第一个客户的？
items.title_en: I Asked 5 Business Owners How They Got Their First Client
items.summary_cn: 获得第一个付费客户是创业中最难的一步。Ali Abdaal在泰国团队静修期间，采访了Lifestyle Business Academy的五位教练——Carol、Nathan、Katherine、Andrea和Owen，让他们分享各自获取第一到第五个客户的真实经历。这些故事揭示了从零到一的关键策略，包括冷启动、人脉转化和内容营销等实用方法。对于正在起步的创业者或自由职业者，这些来自实战的经验极具参考价值，能帮你少走弯路，更快实现从0到1的突破。
items.summary_en: Landing your first paying client is the hardest part of starting a business. During a team offsite in Thailand, Ali Abdaal sat down with five coaches from the Lifestyle Business Academy—Carol, Nathan, Katherine, Andrea, and Owen—and asked them all the same question: how did you actually get your first paying client, and then clients two through five? These stories reveal key strategies for going from zero to one, including cold outreach, leveraging your network, and content marketing. For aspiring entrepreneurs or freelancers, these real-world experiences offer invaluable insights to help you avoid common pitfalls and achieve your first breakthrough faster.

items.title_cn: 如果你野心勃勃却总是三分钟热度，请务必看这个视频
items.title_en: If you're ambitious but inconsistent, please watch this
items.summary_cn: 为什么我们明明知道该做什么，却总是做不到？Ali Abdaal邀请《Beyond Belief》作者Nir Eyal深入对谈，揭示真正阻碍我们的并非自律或动力不足，而是那些从未被审视的深层信念。视频涵盖动力三角模型、游了60小时的老鼠实验、职业倦怠的真实公式，以及Nir用来替换痛苦信念的四个关键问题。如果你也困在"想做却做不到"的循环里，这期对话将帮你从根源上找到突破口，重新理解野心与行动之间的鸿沟。
items.summary_en: Why do we know exactly what to do and still fail to do it?
